encode_sentence_with_roberta: encode a sentence into BPE tokens using the RoBERTa hub interface encode method
decode_roberta_tokens: decode RoBERTa BPE token tensors back into human-readable text using the decode method
extract_features_from_tokens: extract RoBERTa hidden state features from tokenized input using the extract_features method
fill_mask_with_roberta: fill a masked token in a sentence with top-k predictions using the fill_mask method
disambiguate_pronoun_with_roberta: disambiguate a pronoun reference in a sentence using the disambiguate_pronoun WSC method
